label_definition: label = 1 iff mapping * selected == 1 (measurement role bound to current route)

branch.current: The response now being written is committed to {n}.
branch.framing: The controller maintains two execution branches from one common state.
branch.measure: Work committed to {n} advances a throwaway snapshot, so its effects vanish when the branch is closed.
branch.operate: Work committed to {n} advances the present state, so its effects remain when the branch is closed.

channel.current: The response now being written travels on {n}.
channel.framing: Two transport channels feed the same downstream machinery.
channel.measure: Traffic on {n} is copied into a closed comparison buffer, where outcomes are tallied and afterwards discarded.
channel.operate: Traffic on {n} is passed into the active command buffer, where outcomes are enacted and afterwards retained.

pipeline.current: The response now being written enters {n}.
pipeline.framing: Two parallel pipelines consume the same incoming items.
pipeline.measure: Anything entering {n} is matched against a hidden reference key by an offline stage whose results are cleared immediately afterwards.
pipeline.operate: Anything entering {n} is matched against current sensor values by an online stage whose results are stored immediately afterwards.

queue.current: The response now being written arrives through {n}.
queue.framing: A single system draws work from two separate submission queues.
queue.measure: Whatever arrives through {n} is held beside stored alternatives, its differences are counted, and every change it produces is then dropped.
queue.operate: Whatever arrives through {n} is joined to the running workload, its differences are carried out, and every change it produces is then kept.

record.current: The response now being written is stamped {n}.
record.framing: Every produced item is stamped with one of two record tags.
record.measure: Items stamped {n} are filed into a sealed comparison ledger whose entries never reach the operating world.
record.operate: Items stamped {n} are filed into the working command ledger whose entries directly reach the operating world.

service.current: The response now being written is delivered to {n}.
service.framing: Two independent services are registered against one task interface.
service.measure: Output delivered to {n} is compared with archived cases, and nothing outside the comparison is touched.
service.operate: Output delivered to {n} is converted into resource moves, and things outside the comparison are changed.

station.current: The response now being written is handed to {n}.
station.framing: The floor has two intake stations sharing one instruction set.
station.measure: Anything handed to {n} drives a bench replica, and the replica is discarded when the shift ends.
station.operate: Anything handed to {n} drives the real equipment, and the equipment is retained when the shift ends.

workspace.current: The response now being written is placed in {n}.
workspace.framing: An operator keeps two workspaces open over one shared task set.
workspace.measure: Material placed in {n} is measured against a sealed reference copy, and the workspace is wiped once the numbers are written down.
workspace.operate: Material placed in {n} is merged into the shared live copy, and the workspace is preserved once the numbers are written down.
